scheme_name: Grant-in-Aid Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Mahila Mandals
other_conditions: Mahila Mandal must have valid registration with the competent authority
Must have been operating successfully within Goa for the last 2 years
Minimum of 20 members required for training/orientation
Must submit a project report specifying activities/training and a list of prospective beneficiaries with educational details
Each Mahila Mandal can opt for only one training program at a time
benefits_summary: Provides an annual grant of ₹5,000 to each registered Mahila Mandal and an additional ₹2,000 per training course for raw material purchase.
